general: Who you are and what Jarvis calls you.
access: Token for Claude, Cloudflare tunnel and database passwords.
ai: OpenAI key for transcription, meaning search, images and topic sorting.
privacy: What never goes to the AI and what is redacted first.
images: Automatic image descriptions so pictures become searchable.
organizer: The organizer: bundles messages into topics, dates and tasks.
people: Automatic estimate of relationship and tone.
actions: What Claude may do in WhatsApp.
whatsapp: Linking with a pairing code instead of a QR code.
expert: Fine tuning and troubleshooting. Only change if you know why.

OWNER_NAME: How Jarvis refers to you in instructions, summaries and profiles. Empty means "you".
OWN_NAMES: Nicknames or spellings other people use for you. Never taken as the name of another person. Empty means only your name.
MCP_TOKEN: Secret key in the legacy connector URL for Claude. Whoever has it can read your chats and write in your name. Rotating it invalidates the old URL immediately.
MCP_PUBLIC_HOST: The hostname you entered in the Cloudflare tunnel for the MCP server. Used only to display the connector URL.
MCP_LEGACY_TOKEN: On: the old connector URL with the MCP token keeps working. Off: Claude connects only through sign-in (OAuth) with your password.
APP_PUBLIC_URL: Address where the app and Claude reach Jarvis through the Cloudflare tunnel, for example https://jarvis.example.com. It is part of the pairing QR code and the issuer of the sign-in (OAuth).
ADMIN_INTERNAL_SECRET: Lets this interface create pairing codes and set the app password. Valid only inside the Docker network, never reachable through the tunnel.
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN: Makes the MCP server reachable from outside (Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels). When set, the tunnel runs. Pasting the whole install command works too.
POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Main database password. Applies only at the very first start; later change it only through "Rotate", which updates the database too.
MCP_RO_PASSWORD: Password of the MCP database roles
For the restricted roles mcp_ro, mcp_act and mcp_mem. Change only through "Rotate".
OPENAI_API_KEY: Optional. Without a key everything runs locally (slow, warms the Pi), and there is no topic sorting and no image description.
OPENAI_BASE_URL: For OpenAI-compatible providers or a proxy. Applies to topic sorting, image description and the app.
APP_MODEL: Used for reply suggestions and "Ask Jarvis" in the app. Needs an OpenAI key.
ORGANIZER_EXCLUDE_NAMES: Never send these chats to the AI
Chats whose name contains one of these terms go to neither the embedding nor the sorting API. Set this before the first start with a key.
ORGANIZER_REDACT: Remove phone numbers, IBANs, email addresses and link paths before sending to the AI.
PEOPLE_SCRUB: Keep profiles general (no concrete details such as places or events).
TRANSCRIBE_PROVIDER: Automatic = OpenAI when a key is set, otherwise local. Local starts whisper.cpp (slow, about 1.5 GB RAM).
OPENAI_TRANSCRIBE_MODEL: Model used for transcription at OpenAI.
WHISPER_MODEL: Larger is more accurate but slower and needs more memory. Loaded at build time (changing it rebuilds whisper).
WHISPER_LANG: Language code such as de or en, or auto.
TRANSCRIBE_MAX_AGE_DAYS: Only transcribe voice messages up to this age. Empty = automatic (OpenAI: all, local: 14 days).
IMAGE_DESCRIBE: Describes every image with AI so it becomes searchable. Needs an OpenAI key.
IMAGE_DETAIL: low is cheaper but hardly reads text in screenshots.
IMAGE_CONCURRENCY: How many images are described in parallel.
EMBED_PROVIDER: Automatic = OpenAI with a key, otherwise local. Switching recomputes all vectors (takes time, costs money at OpenAI).
EMBED_BATCH: Messages per pass. Empty = automatic (OpenAI 100, local 32).
SEARCH_MAX_TOPIC_DIST: Maximum vector distance at which a topic still counts as a match in search. Smaller is stricter.
ORGANIZER_ENABLED: Starts the organizer. Needs an OpenAI key. Check the cost first under Maintenance → Cost estimate.
ORGANIZER_MODEL: A cheap model with structured output.
ORGANIZER_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET: Upper limit for input plus output per day. After that sorting pauses until tomorrow.
ORGANIZER_PRICE_IN: For the cost estimate. Check the current price with your provider.
ORGANIZER_SETTLE_HOURS: Newer messages wait until the conversation rests.
ORGANIZER_MIN_MESSAGES: A chat is sorted once this many messages are unsorted …
ORGANIZER_MAX_WAIT_HOURS: … or when the oldest one has waited this long.
ORGANIZER_IDLE_MINUTES: Wait time when there is nothing to do.
TOPIC_STALE_DAYS: An open topic without a date and without activity counts as stale after this long.
TOPIC_PAST_GRACE_HOURS: How long after its date a topic stays open.
PEOPLE_MIN_MESSAGES: A profile is only created from this many messages in a one-to-one chat.
PEOPLE_MIN_THEIRS: At least this many messages must come from the other person.
PEOPLE_MIN_INTERVAL_DAYS: A profile is re-assessed at most this often.
PEOPLE_MAX_PER_DAY: Upper limit for people assessments per day.
PEOPLE_GROUP_DELTA: Shared groups changed by this many.
PEOPLE_ACTIVITY_DELTA: Minimum change in messages over the last 90 days.
ENABLE_ACTIONS: Send, vote, react, manage groups. Off = the MCP server is read-only.
REQUIRE_CONFIRM: On: every action shows a preview first and runs only with confirm=true. Off: actions run immediately.
MAX_ACTIONS_PER_HOUR: Protection against abuse and a WhatsApp ban. Queries do not count.
ENABLE_MEMORY: Store notes, reminders, and people and topic corrections.
WA_PAIRING_PHONE: Instead of a QR code: number with country code (for example 4915112345678). Cleared automatically after a successful link.
ADMIN_PORT: Port of this page on the Pi.
ADMIN_BIND: 0.0.0.0 = the whole home network, 127.0.0.1 = only on the Pi itself (access through an SSH tunnel).
JARVIS_SECRETS_DIR: Only with the encrypted vault: folder that ~/jarvis/.env points to (for example /srv/vault/secrets).
